description: Get campaigns. Common FieldNames: Id, Name, Status, State, Type, StartDate, EndDate, DailyBudget, Statistics, ClientInfo, TimeTargeting, NegativeKeywords, BlockedIps, StatusPayment, StatusClarification, SourceId, Currency, Funds, RepresentedBy. Use when the user wants to see Direct campaigns, their states, types, or budgets before changing anything. Do not use it to edit a campaign; call update_campaigns. Do not use it to pause one; call suspend_campaigns.

States.description: Filter by states: CONVERTED, ENDED, OFF, ON, SUSPENDED, ARCHIVED

Statuses.description: Filter by statuses: ACCEPTED, DRAFT, MODERATION, REJECTED

Types.description: Filter by types: TEXT_CAMPAIGN, DYNAMIC_TEXT_CAMPAIGN, MOBILE_APP_CAMPAIGN, CPM_BANNER_CAMPAIGN, SMART_CAMPAIGN, UNIFIED_CAMPAIGN

field_names.description: Fields to return (FieldNames). See tool description for common values.
